rule: Reuse existing identities. Lanes classify context and permitted bridges; they do not create users or transfer authority.

lanes.DBA_LABORATORY_API: Primary DrMarchand’s Laboratory identity for the API Library relationship
lanes.SERVICE: Non-human API, automation, integration, or notification identities
lanes.EXTERNAL: Identities outside internal trust until explicitly introduced

purpose_flags.TEST: Purpose flag only; does not create a separate authority lane.

rules: Email ownership does not itself grant authorization.
A bridge permits an explicit crossing only; it does not merge identities or namespaces.
Bridge reachability is not transitive unless separately registered.
External test identities remain external until explicitly introduced.
Canvas consumes resolved identity context and must not create an independent user authority.
